decisions.title: Connect at Session Start, Not as a Model Tool
decisions.description: main() spawns docs and deploy from MCP_CONFIG, then opens agentLoop. That matches Codex reading [mcp_servers] at session start. The model has no connect_mcp tool.
decisions.alternatives: Expose connect_mcp as a function tool and let the model plug servers in mid-turn. That invents an API Codex does not have and hides that discovery happens before the first LLM call.

zh.title: 会话启动时连接，不是模型工具
zh.description: main() 按 MCP_CONFIG spawn docs 和 deploy，再开 agentLoop。这对应 Codex 在会话启动时读 [mcp_servers]。模型没有 connect_mcp 工具。

decisions.title: Prefix for the Model, Raw Name for the Child
decisions.description: Discovered tools are exposed as mcp__server__tool (Codex still has the legacy mcp__ prefix). tools/call uses the server's raw name, so mcp__docs__search becomes { name: "search" } on the docs child.
decisions.alternatives: Using the raw tool name is shorter, but search from two servers could overwrite each other. Sending the prefixed name to the child would break the MCP server, which only knows search / get_page / trigger.

zh.title: 给模型看前缀，给子进程看原名
zh.description: 发现到的工具暴露为 mcp__server__tool（Codex 仍保留 mcp__ 前缀）。tools/call 用服务器的原始名字，所以 mcp__docs__search 打给 docs 子进程的是 { name: "search" }。

decisions.title: The Loop Does Not Change
decisions.description: MCP responses are appended as function_call_output. agentLoop is unchanged since s01. HTTP, enabled_tools, OAuth, approval, and Codex-as-a-server are other chapters.
decisions.alternatives: A separate external-response channel would make MCP feel special and require extra loop logic.

zh.title: 循环一行没变
zh.description: MCP 响应按 function_call_output 追加。agentLoop 自 s01 起没变。HTTP、enabled_tools、OAuth、审批、Codex 当服务器，都是别的章。
